"Drops" means the source code, shaders and documentation in this repository and
any copy of them installed through the HorizonX Drops registry.

Exception: the Elastic Mesh drop (registry/drops/elastic-mesh, installed as

of its engine file. This license does not apply to it.

"End Product" means a website, web app, mobile app, game, video, presentation or
other finished work in which a Drop is one part, and whose main value comes from
something other than the Drop itself.

1. What you may do

   a. Use, copy and modify the Drops, free of charge, in any number of End
      Products, for yourself or for clients, personal or commercial.
   b. Sell, distribute or give away End Products that contain the Drops, in
      source or compiled form, as long as the Drops are not offered separately
      from the End Product.
   c. Share screenshots and recordings of the Drops and of your End Products.

2. What you may not do

   a. Redistribute, sell, sublicense or publish the Drops, modified or not, on
      their own or as part of a component library, UI kit, template pack,
      registry, design-system package, starter kit, code generator, theme or any
      product whose main purpose is to let other people reuse the Drops.
   b. Include the Drops in a dataset used to train or fine-tune a machine
      learning model, or in a product that generates them on request.
   c. Claim you made the Drops, or remove this notice or the provenance banner
      at the top of each engine file.
   d. Use the HorizonX name or logo to suggest that HorizonX endorses your End
      Product.

3. Attribution

   Attribution in the End Product is appreciated but not required. The notice
   at the top of each file must stay in the source.

4. Relationship to HorizonX plans

   This license covers only the Drops published in this repository. Other
   HorizonX tools, variants, editor exports and assets are covered by the
   HorizonX Terms (https://horizonx.so/terms) and the plan they were obtained
   under.

5. Termination

   If you break this license, your rights under it end automatically. End
   Products you shipped before that and that complied with it may stay
   published.

6. No warranty

   THE DROPS ARE PROVIDED "AS IS", WITHOUT WARRANTY OF ANY KIND, EXPRESS OR
